new_jobs.title: Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Description

About Bankwell:

Bankwell is a commercial bank with more than $3 billion in assets that serves the banking needs of businesses and individuals. At Bankwell, we pride ourselves on our unique ability to bring you high touch, high quality banking with the expertise and dedication of our experienced team of professionals. When it comes to business, our deep industry knowledge, flexibility and innovative treasury and financing services enable us to find the right solutions for our business and commercial clients. We’re passionate about giving back and are actively involved with many not-for-profit organizations that help shape and improve the lives of others. We’re dedicated to giving our time and talent to support the communities we serve. More about Bankwell can be found at www.mybankwell.com.

Summary Of Position

The Business Analyst, Private Client Group serves as a strategic partner to the Head of Private Client Group, exercising independent analytical judgment to provide analytical support, business intelligence, portfolio reporting, project coordination, and day-to-day business support. This role is designed for an individual who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, technologically proficient, fluent in the practical application of AI tools, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced commercial banking environment.

The primary duty of this position is the exercise of discretion and judgment on matters of significance related to the general business operations of the Private Client Group — including data analytics, business intelligence, portfolio and credit-related analysis, and business planning. Approximately 60–65% of this role's time is dedicated to these analytical and business-intelligence functions. The remaining time is spent on business coordination and executive-support functions (meeting management, communication workflows, and calendar/travel coordination), which are secondary to and performed in direct support of the analytical work above, while leveraging AI to drive efficiency across each of these functions.

Responsibilities Include

Data Analytics & Business Intelligence

Develop and maintain commercial lending and deposit dashboards, scorecards and KPI reporting, determine dashboard methodology, data sources, and KPI definitions.
Analyze loan production, pipeline activity, deposits, portfolio concentrations, credit quality metrics, and profitability trends, exercising judgment in identifying which trends warrant escalation to leadership.
Prepare executive-level presentations, reports, and management summaries for senior leadership and Board reporting purposes.
Prepare draft term sheets, including facility descriptions, pricing, covenants, and related structuring language, applying professional judgment to recommend structuring approaches for review by the Head of Private Client Group and Credit.
Identify trends, opportunities, and risks within the portfolio through data analysis, and recommend a course of action based on that analysis.
Support forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning initiatives — including developing underlying assumptions and modeling approaches.
Create automated reporting solutions to reduce manual processes and improve efficiency, with discretion over tool selection and design.
Own CRM, pipeline management, and business development reporting.
Monitor lender productivity, portfolio growth, and client activity metrics.
Perform ad hoc analysis to support lending decisions, strategic initiatives, and special projects.

AI & Automation

Leverage AI and generative tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to enhance data analysis, reporting, forecasting, and portfolio monitoring, and to draft communications, term sheets, and briefing materials.
Identify, implement, and champion AI-driven automation opportunities that reduce manual processes across lending operations, reporting, and business support, ensuring alignment with data governance, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

Business Coordination & Executive Support (Secondary Function)

Coordinate the Head of Private Client Group's calendar, scheduling, travel arrangements, and meeting logistics, exercising discretion in prioritizing competing demands on the Head's time.
Prioritize and manage incoming communications, including email organization, draft responses, and follow-up tracking, using thoughtful judgment to triage and route matters requiring the Head's attention.
Organize internal and external meetings, including preparation of agendas, materials, and action-item follow-up.
Maintain task lists, project timelines, and key deliverable tracking.
Prepare meeting summaries and briefing documents.
Serve as a liaison between commercial lending leadership, credit administration, operations, treasury management, and executive management.
Assist in the preparation of presentations and communication materials.

Private Client Group Administration

Maintain pipeline and portfolio tracking systems.
Collaborate on loan committee preparation by gathering, organizing, and validating information, and by flagging data anomalies requiring follow-up.
Coordinate special projects involving process improvements and technology implementations.
Support vendor and third-party management activities related to lending systems and reporting platforms.
Maintain centralized reporting repositories and departmental documentation.
Assist with examination, audit, and regulatory reporting requests as needed.

Requirements

Qualifications & Skills:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related field.
2–5 years of experience in commercial banking, financial services, business analytics, or a related support role.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, Power Query, lookup functions, dashboard development, and financial modeling.
Proficiency with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.
Demonstrated proficiency with AI and automation tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar), including practical experience applying AI to analytics, reporting, or administrative workflows.
Strong PowerPoint and presentation development skills.
Experience working with CRM systems and lending platforms preferred.
Familiarity with commercial lending, credit analysis, term sheet preparation, and banking operations is strongly preferred.
Exceptional organizational and project management skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to manage confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

Key Competencies

Analytical thinking
AI fluency and automation mindset
Executive presence
Attention to detail
Process improvement mindset
Technology proficiency
Time management
Relationship management
Problem solving
Initiative and accountability
Professional communication

FLSA Status: Exempt

All employees are expected to perform tasks assigned by supervisory personnel, regardless of job titles or routine job duties.

new_jobs.description:
Duration: 12 Months

Details:
  We are seeking a contractor to provide hands-on execution support of FR2052a production.  The role will help ensure data used for regulatory reporting is well-controlled, traceable end-to-end, and supported by clear documentation and governance.

Project:

Primary FR 2052a deliverable:
Adhere to governance model and document controls across technology, maker/checkers and report owners (e.g., ownership, attestations, issues, change management).

Candidate Value Proposition:
The successful candidate will have the opportunity to: drive visible, regulatory-facing deliverables; work at the intersection of liquidity reporting, data governance, and operational resilience; and partner closely with Finance, Treasury, Technology, and Risk to improve data quality and control discipline.

Typical Day in Role:
Run the FR 2052a production process:
Source-to-report mappings, key calculations, material assumptions
Write BRDs for technology
Ensure version control and audit-ready evidence
Partner with data owners, SMEs, and technology teams to generate accurate and timely reporting and map processes to governance and controls (controls inventory, control descriptions, testing artifacts, issue management)
Working with Technology, Treasury, Finance, Risk, and Data Management teams to investigate data issues and implement sustainable solutions.

Candidate Requirements/Must Have Skills:
5+ years of experience in Treasury, Liquidity Risk Management, Regulatory Reporting, or Finance within a banking environment.
Direct hands-on experience producing and managing the FR2052a Complex Institution Liquidity Monitoring Report, preferably in a daily T+2 reporting environment (Strong understanding of FR2052a instructions, reporting schedules, data sourcing, regulatory interpretations, and governance requirements.)
5+ years of recent experience executing end-to-end report production, including data validation, reconciliations, exception management, issue resolution, and regulatory submission support.
Experience documenting business requirements and process improvements through Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, process flows, and data mapping documentation.
Demonstrated experience leading and executing User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test script development, defect management, and validation of regulatory reporting enhancements.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, data analysis, reconciliations, pivot tables, and large dataset manipulation.

Nice-To-Have Skills:
Experience supporting other regulatory liquidity reports (LCR, NSFR, FR Y-15, 6G FR2052a, Resolution Planning, Reg YY reporting).
Ability to analyze and assess new products, business initiatives, and transactions to determine appropriate FR2052a reporting treatment and data requirements.
Strong knowledge of banking products and balance sheet activities, including deposits, loans, secured funding, derivatives, prime brokerage, securities financing transactions, and capital markets products.
Familiarity with SQL, data warehouses, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, and reporting automation initiatives.
Experience supporting regulatory examinations, internal audits, or remediation programs.

Soft Skills Required:
Hands-on, execution-oriented mindset with a willingness to roll up sleeves and resolve issues independently.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, audit-ready deliverables.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to challenge assumptions, investigate discrepancies, and drive issues to resolution.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across business and technology teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple deliverables simultaneously.
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced regulatory reporting environment with tight deadlines and changing priorities.

Education & Certificates:
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Information Systems, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
Preferred: CPA, CFA, FRM, PMP, CBAP, or data governance/control certifications (e.g., CDMP) or equivalent practical experience.

Best VS. Average Candidate:
The ideal candidate will have recent deep, hands-on FR2052a production experience and be viewed as a subject matter expert on liquidity reporting. They will proactively identify reporting risks, investigate data issues to root cause, translate regulatory requirements into clear business requirements, and partner effectively with technology teams to deliver sustainable solutions.
They will possess strong capital markets product knowledge and confidently assess the regulatory reporting impact of new products, transactions, and business initiatives while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and control.

Overview

Gray Dawes Travel is a multi-award winning, global travel management company with offices in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada and the Netherlands. Established in 1927, we’re constantly growing by using technology and our passion for what we do to keep evolving. As one of the fastest growing Travel Management Companies in the world, we help businesses travel smarter, more efficiently, and more sustainably. But we go beyond that – we become an extension of our clients, where their success is our success.
With a laser focus on offering our clients a high touch, high tech, high content experience, at Gray Dawes we’re not just there to deliver the best corporate travel fares, the most innovative itineraries, the slickest online tools or the most experienced consultants.
